SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_encounters FROM encounters LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS distinct_female_patients FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' AND p.gender = 'F' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(p.income) AS average_income FROM patients AS p JOIN conditions AS c ON p.id = c.patient WHERE c.description = 'Essential hypertension' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.city = 'Boston' LIMIT 100
SELECT p.gender, COUNT(*) AS emergency_encounter_count FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'emergency' GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY p.gender LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(e.total_claim_cost) AS total_claim_cost FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.deathdate IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS condition_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN encounters AS e ON c.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'inpatient' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS medication_count FROM medications AS m JOIN encounters AS e ON m.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'emergency' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS procedure_count FROM procedures AS p JOIN encounters AS e ON p.encounter = e.id WHERE e.encounterclass = 'wellness' LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(encounter_count) AS avg_encounters_per_patient FROM (SELECT p.id, COUNT(e.id) AS encounter_count FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN encounters AS e ON p.id = e.patient GROUP BY p.id) AS sub LIMIT 100
SELECT p.race, AVG(p.income) AS avg_income FROM patients AS p GROUP BY p.race ORDER BY avg_income DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_patients FROM patients AS p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM encounters AS e WHERE e.patient = p.id AND e.encounterclass = 'emergency') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM encounters AS e WHERE e.patient = p.id AND e.encounterclass = 'inpatient') LIMIT 100
SELECT p.gender, AVG(e.total_claim_cost) AS average_total_claim_cost FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id GROUP BY p.gender ORDER BY p.gender LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS distinct_patients FROM conditions AS c JOIN medications AS m ON c.patient = m.patient WHERE c.description ILIKE '%essential hypertension%' AND m.description ILIKE '%lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet%' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_without_allergies FROM patients AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allergies AS a WHERE a.patient = p.id) LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_systolic_bp FROM observations AS o JOIN patients AS p ON o.patient = p.id WHERE o.description = 'Systolic blood pressure' AND p.gender = 'M' LIMIT 100
SELECT e.encounterclass AS class, COUNT(*) AS count FROM encounters AS e JOIN patients AS p ON e.patient = p.id WHERE p.income > 100000 GROUP BY e.encounterclass ORDER BY e.encounterclass LIMIT 100
SELECT SUM(m.dispenses) AS total_dispenses FROM medications AS m JOIN patients AS p ON m.patient = p.id WHERE p.gender = 'F' LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(*) AS procedure_count FROM procedures AS p JOIN patients AS pt ON p.patient = pt.id WHERE pt.deathdate IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(i.base_cost) AS avg_base_cost FROM immunizations AS i JOIN patients AS p ON i.patient = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthdate) >= 2000 LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE), p.birthdate))) AS avg_age FROM patients AS p WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conditions AS c WHERE c.patient = p.id AND (c.description ILIKE '%prediabetes%' OR c.code ILIKE '%prediabetes%')) LIMIT 100

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT e.patient) AS patient_count FROM encounters AS e WHERE e.start >= CAST('2018-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND e.start < CAST('2023-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT e.encounterclass, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN e.total_claim_cost > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM encounters AS e GROUP BY e.encounterclass ORDER BY e.encounterclass LIMIT 100

SELECT c.description, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.birthdate < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND (p.deathdate IS NULL OR p.deathdate >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AND (p.deathdate IS NULL OR p.deathdate > CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AND (p.birthdate < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '18 YEARS' OR p.birthdate < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AND (p.deathdate IS NULL OR p.deathdate >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AND (p.birthdate < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '18 YEARS') GROUP BY c.description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) > 20 LIMIT 100
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_claim_cost) AS median_total_claim_cost FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency' LIMIT 100
SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (stop - start))) AS avg_duration_days FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'inpatient' LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient) AS patient_count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE c.description = 'Diabetes mellitus type 2 (disorder)' AND c.start < (p.birthdate + INTERVAL '40 YEARS') LIMIT 100
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start) AS INT) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM encounters WHERE encounterclass = 'emergency' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start) ORDER BY count DESC, month ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT i.patient) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patients) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM immunizations AS i WHERE i.description LIKE 'COVID-19%' LIMIT 100

SELECT p.gender, AVG(CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL)) AS average_bmi FROM observations AS o JOIN patients AS p ON o.patient = p.id WHERE o.description = 'Body mass index (BMI) [Ratio]' AND (CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - p.birthdate) / 365.25 >= 18 GROUP BY p.gender LIMIT 100
SELECT e.patient AS patient_id, SUM(e.total_claim_cost) AS total_claim_cost FROM encounters AS e GROUP BY e.patient HAVING SUM(e.total_claim_cost) > 750000 LIMIT 100

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) AS year, SUM(e.total_claim_cost) AS total FROM encounters AS e WHERE e.start >= CAST('2015-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND e.start < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(last_enc - first_enc) AS avg_days_between_first_and_last FROM (SELECT patient, CAST(MIN(start) AS DATE) AS first_enc, CAST(MAX(start) AS DATE) AS last_enc FROM encounters GROUP BY patient HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS sub LIMIT 100
SELECT m.description, COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient) AS patient_count FROM medications AS m GROUP BY m.description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient) > 150 ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS living_patients_over_80_with_3_active_conditions FROM patients AS p JOIN conditions AS c ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL AND p.birthdate <= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '80 YEARS' AND c.stop IS NULL GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 LIMIT 100
SELECT (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthdate) - (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthdate) % 10)) AS decade, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients AS p GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient) AS distinct_patients FROM observations AS o WHERE o.encounter IS NOT NULL AND ((o.description ILIKE '%systolic%' AND CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL) >= 140) OR (o.description ILIKE '%diastolic%' AND CAST(o.value AS DECIMAL) >= 90)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM observations AS o2 WHERE o2.encounter = o.encounter AND o2.patient = o.patient AND ((o2.description ILIKE '%systolic%' AND CAST(o2.value AS DECIMAL) >= 140) AND (o2.description ILIKE '%diastolic%' AND CAST(o2.value AS DECIMAL) >= 90))) LIMIT 100

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.start) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM conditions AS c JOIN patients AS p ON c.patient = p.id WHERE p.city = 'Boston' AND c.start >= CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.start < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.start) ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT year, encounter_count, SUM(encounter_count) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS cumulative_encounters FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters AS e WHERE e.start >= CAST('2020-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND e.start < CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.start) AS INT)) AS yearly ORDER BY year LIMIT 100

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FILTER(WHERE c.patient IS NOT NULL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS percentage FROM patients AS p LEFT JOIN conditions AS c ON c.patient = p.id AND c.description = 'Normal pregnancy (finding)' WHERE p.deathdate IS NULL AND p.gender = 'F' AND p.birthdate <= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '15 YEARS' AND p.birthdate > CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '50 YEARS' LIMIT 100
